prompt_name.description:
The name of the prompt that should be used by for encoding. If not set, no prompt
will be applied.

Must be a key in the `sentence-transformers` configuration `prompts` dictionary.

For example if ``prompt_name`` is "query" and the ``prompts`` is {"query": "query: ", ...},
then the sentence "What is the capital of France?" will be encoded as
"query: What is the capital of France?" because the prompt text will be prepended before
any text to encode.

EncodingFormat.description:
Embedding representation, not model compute precision. `tensor` returns portable
little-endian float32 with explicit shape and dtype: JSON base64 or MessagePack bin.
`float` keeps numeric arrays; legacy `base64` keeps native-endian float32 vectors.

data.description: Base64 encoded bytes. Not decoded by request deserialization.

ContentPart.description:
Accepted wire spellings normalize before model validation and rendering.
Serialization continues to use the existing ContentPart spellings.

EmbeddingInput.description:
Embedding input: text, final token IDs, batches of either, or one conversation.
A message list always describes one input, regardless of the number of turns.
An empty array is parsed as an empty text batch and rejected by the request handler.

url.description: Remote URL or inline data URL; fetching is a processor responsibility.

MessageRole.description:
Roles supported by the initial conversation contract. Additional roles require
explicit metadata and adapter support, rather than being silently discarded.

allOf.description:
SGLang-compatible classification, with native messages and truncation extensions.
Provide exactly one of input or messages. String arrays are independent inputs.

model.description: Served model name; required for multi-model deployments.

priority.description: Only absent or zero priority is supported.

use_activation.description:
vLLM extension: `false` returns raw logits instead of softmax probabilities, which
one-label cross-encoders need for a usable relevance score.

ClassifyRequest.description: Provide exactly one of input or messages; a message list is one conversation.

ModelInput.description:
A plain text state or an explicitly structured native conversation.
Message objects are never interpreted as text or silently flattened.

SystemOneRequest.description:
OneJev (including Elephant/Mammoth), Rune, Clef, Laya and Perplexity v1.1.
Top-level images/videos are rejected with HTTP 422. Image-capable OneJev/Rune
models accept user image_url content parts inside state.messages instead.

oneOf.description: Arbitrary JSON object without the reserved messages key.

SystemOneState.description: Text, a JSON array/object, or Infinity's native conversation envelope. Objects with messages must match MessageInput. Supported roles and media depend on the selected model: OneJev accepts user/assistant text and user image_url parts, with image detail omitted or auto; Laya rejects conversations. Content parts use Chat Completions-style names; this is not an OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses, or Decisions endpoint.

Tensor.description:
Packed public output values, independent of the backend's internal precision.
Storage is contiguous C-order, little-endian, without padding or a tensor header.

dtype.description: Public output dtype, independent of backend precision. Only float32 is supported.

shape.description: Element counts: [dimensions] or [tokens, dimensions]; never byte counts.

SystemOneRequestBody.description: Use the schema for the selected model's decision protocol. OneJev (Elephant/Mammoth), Rune, Clef, Laya and Perplexity v1.1 use SystemOneRequest. D3 and Vela3 core decisions use D3SystemOneRequest; Vela3 encoders support choice/noul only, and fast-vision accepts up to three images and no videos. Vela3 task adapters and span extraction are not enabled. Perplexity joint v1.2 uses its top-level media format. Model is required when multiple models are loaded.

D3SystemOneRequest.description:
D3 accepts arbitrary JSON states and top-level media shared by every question.
Objects containing messages are serialized as JSON, not interpreted as native conversations.

images.description: Ordered remote URLs or inline data URLs, subject to configured media limits and host policy.

videos.description: Ordered video sources; supported only by the D3 protocol.

PplxJointSystemOneRequest.description: Perplexity joint v1.2 (pplx-decider-flash-v1.2): arbitrary JSON state and shared top-level images. Nonempty videos are rejected. Native state.messages is serialized as JSON, not interpreted as a conversation.

images.description: Ordered remote URLs or inline data URLs, subject to configured media limits and host policy.

videos.description: Must be omitted or empty for this protocol.

dtype.description: Public output dtype, independent of backend precision. Only float32 is supported.

shape.description: Element counts: [dimensions] or [tokens, dimensions]; never byte counts.

ServiceTier.description: Priority receives a virtual queue-age bonus; flex receives an offset. Equal virtual times retain admission order. The input alias "auto" selects default.
